CONVENTION QUESTION, not a research finding. P0477 is the South Valley SYSTEM/NETWORK row (930 km) and its six segments (P6697 90, P6698 28, P6699 150, P6700 150, P6701 121, P6702 390 km) already carry applied 'high' routes summing to 929 km. Do not apply without that decision.
